name: borrowher-igdtuw
description: BorrowHer — An IGDTUW-exclusive campus sharing economy platform built using React, Firebase and Vercel.

scripts.build: npm run --prefix functions build && npm run --prefix frontend build
scripts.lint: npm run --prefix functions lint && npm run --prefix frontend lint
scripts.test: vitest run tests/unit && npm run --prefix frontend test
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-borrowher --only auth,firestore,storage "vitest run tests/rules --fileParallelism=false"
scripts.test:all: vitest run tests/unit && npm run --prefix frontend test && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-borrowher --only auth,firestore,storage "vitest run tests/rules --fileParallelism=false"
